description: The City and County of Denver publishes stormwater sewer-main lines through Wastewater Management. Its layer schema includes upstream and downstream node identifiers and elevations, slope, pipe dimensions, material, ownership, installation date, lifecycle status and drainage-basin fields. These geometry and asset attributes can support research on stormwater-network flow. The presence of fields does not establish that every feature has a valid value or that the network is hydraulically connected. Observation dates, field completeness and model readiness remain unverified. The provider explicitly labels the data as not for engineering purposes and disclaims accuracy and completeness. Those use constraints remain attached to this record. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies provider use constraints. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue.
